_note: The six life areas, in booklet order. ids are stable; never store translated names as keys.

ethics: Your convictions, your spiritual life and the principles you live by.
mind: How you grow in knowledge, understanding and skill.
society: Friendships, service and your place among other people.
family: Your spouse, your children and the home you share.
work: Your calling at work, how you do it, and how you handle money.
